E0807

A `yield`ed value's type doesn't match the stream's element type (D-STREAMYIELD1)

What

A `yield`ed value's type doesn't match the stream's element type (D-STREAMYIELD1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0807

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0807: tests/ui/yield_type_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E0807]: this yields String (text), but the stream is `Stream<Int (a whole number)>`
  --> tests/ui/yield_type_mismatch.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     yield "not an int"
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: every `yield` in a generator must hand back the stream's element type
 Fix: use Int (a whole number) here
